evidence: The experimental arrangement was essentially the same as that reported earlier. 2 TaCl 5 and H20 were used as reagents to grow Ta20 5 films and ZnCl 2 and H2S to grow ZnS films. TaC15 and ZnCl 2 were produced as projected molecular beam pulses from effusion ovens [Knudsen cells) and H20 and H2S as gas pulses from gas containers.
